intention: The gateway reads the latest vehicle state from analytics.vehicle_metrics instead of telemetry.vehicle_snapshots, and the dashboard's Vehicle Status card shows locked and sentry-mode badges.
request: Source ticket: MAG-12 - Show Fields on Vehicle Status section. (1) Mirror locked, sentry_mode, car_version, inside_temp_c, outsite_temp_c from vehicle_snapshots into vehicle_metrics via UpsertVehicleMetric on the nightly job. (2) GET /dashboard -> handlers.dashboardFor and mapDashboardSnapshot read from vehicle_metrics instead of telemetryReader.LatestSnapshotsByAccount, via a new API using the same logic. (3) Vehicle Status section: remove the Status field, show locked/unlocked in a different colour (locked in green), add a sentry_mode label. (4) Update the KB for dashboard pages to record analytics.vehicle_metrics as the data source.

decisions.decision: Add 8 columns to vehicle_metrics, not the ticket's 5: plus charging_state, charge_limit_soc_pct, captured_at
decisions.why: mapDashboardSnapshot reads 9 Snapshot fields; without these 3 the dashboard would have to query telemetry too, defeating the ticket's purpose

decisions.decision: No backfill. All 8 columns nullable; existing rows stay NULL forever
decisions.why: Minimal migration. Cost: up to one nightly cycle of blank tiles after deploy, and NULL on sentry_mode becomes ambiguous

decisions.decision: All 4 gateway LatestSnapshotsByAccount call sites move to the analytics port, not only dashboardFor
decisions.why: Owner's explicit call, wider than the ticket. Verified all 4 sites' field needs are covered by the 8 new + 3 existing columns

decisions.decision: Locked/sentry as ui.Badge in the card header; Status stat tile removed; stat grid becomes 3 columns; dashSubtitle keeps StatusLabel
decisions.why: ui.StatTile has no colour prop and adding one would change the shared ui/ kit for one page; ui.Badge already has Kind

decisions.decision: Locked=success, Unlocked=error, NULL hidden; Sentry On=warning, Off=ghost, nil hidden; reuse the six existing vehicles.* i18n keys
decisions.why: Distinguishes off from unknown without a noisy pill; no new catalogue keys, so both languages are already complete

decisions.decision: The kkpa/context/ KB update is in scope, done in tier 2 alongside the change it documents
decisions.why: Ticket section 4 states it explicitly; CLAUDE.md forbids leaving docs stale as a follow-up

decisions.decision: Tier order not put to the user
decisions.why: Forced by dependency: tier 2 consumes the port and columns tier 1 creates. No alternative existed

tiers.notes: Artifacts created and validated; database design gate confirmed by the owner with one revision (idx_vehicle_metrics_latest added). Implementation not started.
